player_prompt.intro:
Mwauka kweni Frozen Lake!

Mwini wake ndi 'P' ku gridi.
Mawonekedwe a gridi:
  ' ' = Thundu la mchere (linaloweza kufikiri)
  'H' = Shimo (ukatike na upotee!)
  'G' = Lengo (fikie hapa ili ushindel)
  'P' = Nafasi yako iliyonayo

Zithunzi zilizonse: juu, chini, kushoto, kulia (au w, a, s, d)
Tumia uthibitisho wako kama: [up], [down], [left], [right] or [w], [a], [s], [d]

Lengo: Fikirani kutoka kwa mwanzo (juu-kushoto) hadi lenge (chini-kulia) bila kuanguka katika mashimo yoyote!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mtundikilo wa ntchito siwafwana. Gwiritsani ntchito [up], [down], [left], [right] kapena [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.unknown_action: Ntchito yosazindikirika '{action}'. Gwiritsani ntchito mmwamba, pansi, kumanzere, kumanja kapena w, a, s, d.

outcome.fell_in_hole: Wakuwa mu chibuwu! Masewera atha. Mwatha {pct}% ya ulendo ku cholingacho.
outcome.turn_limit: Mwafika pa mphaka ya turn! Game over. Mwatha {pct}% wa ulendo ku chilato.
